name: Onboarding Documentation and Identity Integrity
description: Inherent-risk factors seen during onboarding and refresh that suggest false, altered or reused identity information. Covers document fraud, inconsistent details, fictitious addresses and identifiers shared across unrelated customers.

sources.text: FATF, Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach (sector-specific guidance series, general principles)
FATF Recommendations, Recommendation 1 and Interpretive Note (assessing risks and applying a risk-based approach)
Wolfsberg Group, Guidance on a Risk Based Approach for Managing Money Laundering Risks (2006)

indicators.name: Suspected forged or altered identity document
indicators.canon: Identity document tampering or forensic failure
indicators.desc: Identity document or selfie shows alteration, font or layout anomalies, or fails security-feature or forensic checks (including deepfake or injection artefacts).
indicators.ctx: Document shows signs of tampering, font or layout anomalies, or fails security-feature checks.
indicators.fp: Worn or poorly scanned genuine documents can fail checks.

indicators.name: Inconsistent personal details across documents
indicators.canon: Inconsistent personal details across documents or sources
indicators.desc: Names, dates of birth, addresses or national ID numbers differ between documents, bureaux or the application.
indicators.ctx: Names, dates of birth or addresses differ between documents or from the application.
indicators.fp: Transliteration, marriage name changes and typos are common.

indicators.name: Fictitious or unverifiable address
indicators.desc: Address does not exist, is a mail drop, or fails verification against authoritative data.
indicators.ctx: Address does not exist, is a mail drop, or fails verification against authoritative data.
indicators.fp: New builds and rural addresses may not be in databases.

indicators.name: Shared identifiers across unrelated customers
indicators.desc: Same phone, email, address, device or ID number appears across multiple unrelated customers or users.
indicators.ctx: Same phone, email, address, device or ID number appears across multiple unrelated customers.
indicators.fp: Families and shared households legitimately share details.

indicators.name: Synthetic or fabricated identity indicators
indicators.canon: Synthetic identity with thin or newly created footprint
indicators.desc: Thin or recently created credit and digital footprint, with mixed attributes suggesting a fabricated identity.
indicators.ctx: Thin or newly created credit and digital footprint, mixed attributes from different real persons.
indicators.fp: Young or recently arrived people have thin files.

indicators.name: Documents reused across applications
indicators.canon: Documents or images reused or templated across applicants
indicators.desc: Same document image, selfie, template, font or background appears across different applicants or after rejection.
indicators.ctx: Same image or document submitted for different applicants or after previous rejection.
indicators.fp: Resubmission after a poor-quality upload is legitimate.

indicators.name: Expired, unusual or low-assurance documents
indicators.desc: Applicant offers documents of limited reliability or unusual types without explanation.
indicators.ctx: Applicant offers documents of limited reliability or unusual types without explanation.

indicators.name: Applicant details match watchlist or fraud record
indicators.canon: Applicant details match watchlist or fraud record
indicators.desc: Application data matches known fraud, mule or exited-customer records.
indicators.ctx: Application data matches known fraud, mule or exited-customer records.

indicators.name: Pressure to complete onboarding quickly
indicators.canon: Pressure to speed up or bypass checks
indicators.desc: Customer or intermediary urges rapid completion, secrecy or bypassing of checks, or leans on personal connections.
indicators.ctx: Customer or intermediary urges bypassing checks or relies on personal connections.

indicators.name: Signature or contact details differ on later instructions
indicators.canon: Signature or contact details differ on later instructions
indicators.desc: Later instructions carry signatures or contact details that depart from onboarding records.
indicators.ctx: Later instructions carry signatures or contact details that depart from onboarding records.
